title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recap for call queue calls in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The rollout, recording-access boundary and documented recording controls are supported. The licensing classification needs correction: this is a new option inside the already licensed Queues app, not a separately documented add-on for call queue recap; retain the caveat that recap-specific licensing is not yet published.

claims.claim: The add-on licensing classification conflicts with the standard's treatment of a new option inside an already licensed product.
claims.quote:
model: "add-on"
cost: Low. The only cost the sources show is admin time to review licences; Queues app users already need Teams Phone and Teams Premium, and a licence specific to recap on call queue calls is not yet published.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "included" under the standard's product-level entitlement rule. Keep the notes naming Teams Phone and Teams Premium for Queues app and saying no requirement specific to call queue recap is published. This does not assert a separately verified recap-specific licence.
